subject: p-fc
title: P.FC.------POL.CON.
description: Chart on book p. 175 (EVOL-13). P-FC (particular focus) is the subject; POL-CON (political consciousness) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics), TR (transformation) and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From SPT-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: V-SY (value system). From TR: C-CONT (composite continuance). From C-CONT: EXP-CONT-1 (expansion condition (composite focus)). From INDIV-TD: PER-DY (perception dynamics). From PER-DY: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From INFO-DE-B: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
